customer_addresses_lat_lng_check.name: customer_addresses_lat_lng_check
customer_addresses_lat_lng_check.value: ("customer_addresses"."lat" is null) = ("customer_addresses"."lng" is null) and "customer_addresses"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "customer_addresses"."lng" between -180 and 180

staff_busy_blocks_period_check.name: staff_busy_blocks_period_check
staff_busy_blocks_period_check.value: not isempty("staff_busy_blocks"."period") and not lower_inf("staff_busy_blocks"."period") and not upper_inf("staff_busy_blocks"."period")

care_records_ratings_check.name: care_records_ratings_check
care_records_ratings_check.value: "care_records"."record_type" = 'daily_report' or ("care_records"."risk_rating" is null and "care_records"."es_rating" is null)

legacy_imported_rows_target_check.name: legacy_imported_rows_target_check
legacy_imported_rows_target_check.value: case when "legacy_imported_rows"."source" = 'gas_receipt' then "legacy_imported_rows"."receipt_id" is not null and "legacy_imported_rows"."care_record_id" is null else "legacy_imported_rows"."care_record_id" is not null and "legacy_imported_rows"."receipt_id" is null end

receipts_tenant_id_dedupe_hash_idx.name: receipts_tenant_id_dedupe_hash_idx
receipts_tenant_id_dedupe_hash_idx.where: dedupe_hash is not null and cancelled_at is null

receipts_cancel_check.name: receipts_cancel_check
receipts_cancel_check.value: ("receipts"."cancelled_at" is null and "receipts"."cancelled_by" is null and "receipts"."cancel_reason" is null) or ("receipts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "receipts"."cancelled_by" is not null)

report_ai_generations_levels_check.name: report_ai_generations_levels_check
report_ai_generations_levels_check.value: "report_ai_generations"."education_level" between 1 and 5 and "report_ai_generations"."effective_education_level" between 1 and 5 and "report_ai_generations"."risk_rating" between 1 and 5

report_keywords_education_level_check.name: report_keywords_education_level_check
report_keywords_education_level_check.value: "report_keywords"."education_level_min" between 1 and 5 and "report_keywords"."education_level_max" between 1 and 5 and "report_keywords"."education_level_min" <= "report_keywords"."education_level_max"

report_phrases_psi_check.name: report_phrases_psi_check
report_phrases_psi_check.value: "report_phrases"."psi_min" between 1 and 5 and "report_phrases"."psi_max" between 1 and 5 and "report_phrases"."psi_min" <= "report_phrases"."psi_max" and ("report_phrases"."kind" = 'warm' or ("report_phrases"."psi_min" = 1 and "report_phrases"."psi_max" = 5))

staff_home_lat_lng_check.name: staff_home_lat_lng_check
staff_home_lat_lng_check.value: ("staff"."home_lat" is null) = ("staff"."home_lng" is null) and "staff"."home_lat" between -90 and 90 and "staff"."home_lng" between -180 and 180
